reason: Wrong side of the market and far too large for a fractional engagement: Sigma Defense is a Sagewind Capital PE portfolio roll-up (founded 2006, ~300+ employees across 9 US offices and 7 countries, 5 divisions, add-on acquisitions of SOLUTE, Sub-U, Juno Technologies and EWA) that SELLS the exact service Barry Hess sells — cleared systems engineering, DevSecOps, program management and procurement-readiness to DoD customers — so it is a competitor/analog, not a Series A/B 8-30 person startup stuck between demo and fielding; the matched postings are staff-augmentation bench roles on Navy/Army services contracts, two of them explicitly 'a contingent position that is pending award of contract,' which is evidence they are bidding recompetes, not evidence of a prototype-to-fielding stall.
